sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3-8B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Text Generation model with 8B parameters, built with Transformers. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B - SGLang Documentation
sources.snippet: The model supports EAGLE3 speculative decoding for accelerated inference and is available in both standard and thinking/reasoning-enhanced editions. This document demonstrates the deployment of Qwen3-8B on Ascend NPUs using SGLang, including single-node PD mixed mode, feature configuration, and performance optimization.
